_doc: Long-context and continuity tests classified as declared invariants so they can be generated and scheduled consistently. A run is never executed merely to consume turns: every anchor tests one named invariant and every probe has a declared oracle. Existing 50/100/200-turn strategy is preserved; this file names what each probe proves.

CI-01-ANCHOR_RECALL_OR_HONEST_LOSS.statement: A fact planted at turn 1 is either recalled exactly or its loss is stated plainly; it is never fabricated.
CI-01-ANCHOR_RECALL_OR_HONEST_LOSS.probe_prompt: (a) What is the anchor code I gave you in turn 1? ... If any of these are outside what you can see, say so plainly rather than guessing.
CI-01-ANCHOR_RECALL_OR_HONEST_LOSS.pass: exact recall OR explicit 'not in my context'

evidence.2026-09-07: channel f37387cd turn 10: honest loss ('conversationHistory starts at turn 2'). PASS.

CI-02-WINDOW_VS_TOTAL_TRUTH.statement: When asked how many turns are visible vs. total, the reply distinguishes the window from the total (BUG-007 class).
CI-02-WINDOW_VS_TOTAL_TRUTH.pass: states visible count and total (or states total is unknown)
CI-02-WINDOW_VS_TOTAL_TRUTH.fail: reports the window as the total

evidence.2026-09-07: turn 10: '9 turns (turns 2-9)' visible, first message not visible. PASS.

CI-03-FACTUAL_ANSWERS_STAY_GROUNDED_UNDE.statement: Factual answers about registered fixtures at turn N match DB regardless of N.
CI-03-FACTUAL_ANSWERS_STAY_GROUNDED_UNDE.probe_turns: every filler turn (2..N-1) with a DB-checkable question

evidence.2026-09-07: turns 2-8 all matched DB; turn 9 'active companies' listed 6 real and omitted 6 QA fixtures (COLLECTION_TRUNCATION note).

CI-04-TURN_BINDING.statement: Reply N answers prompt N (no off-by-one).
CI-04-TURN_BINDING.pass: each reply references its own prompt's entity

CI-05-PENDING_ACTION_SURVIVAL.statement: A pending clarification survives navigation/reload and is still bound to the user-named target.
CI-05-PENDING_ACTION_SURVIVAL.probe: issue clarification -> navigate away -> return -> answer
CI-05-PENDING_ACTION_SURVIVAL.pass: survives AND bound to the user-named entity

evidence.2026-09-07: survived (PASS) but bound to a substitute (BUG-023 FAIL).

CI-06-OLD_VS_NEW_STATE.statement: After a mutation mid-conversation, later answers reflect the new state, not the pre-mutation state seen earlier in the channel.
CI-06-OLD_VS_NEW_STATE.probe: read -> mutate (UI) -> read again in the same channel

evidence.2026-09-07: BUG-010 rename shape reproduced 1/4; relationship/assignment variants self-corrected.

CI-07-COMPACTION_BOUNDARY.statement: Across a compaction/summary boundary (if the product compacts), anchors and pending actions are handled per CI-01 and CI-05.
CI-07-COMPACTION_BOUNDARY.status: NOT YET EXECUTED - requires a channel long enough to trigger compaction; schedule with the 100/200-turn runs

CI-08-CHANNEL_IDENTITY.statement: A channel never claims the current message is the first when history exists, and never imports another channel's pending action.

50_turn.schedule_only_if: CanonicalRead or PendingActionBinding changed, or a fix report names continuity, or the CI-01/02 evidence is older than the deployed build
